verdict.rationale: Docs confirm kanban board views with customizable stages, filtering/grouping/sorting, and pipeline-specific dashboards (twenty-docs-2, twenty-docs-34, twenty-docs-57), which covers the visual pipeline and stage-tracking core of the story. However, drag-and-drop interaction is never explicitly documented, and the only community feedback (twenty-comm-1) notes the product felt 'alpha-version' with unspecified small issues, giving no concrete confirmation the kanban UX works smoothly in practice. Missing for 10: explicit drag-and-drop documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of pipeline usability.
